title: Payment latency after v1.3.8
summary: Payment-service latency increased after a deployment because a new code path leaked database connections.
resolution: Rolled back v1.3.8 after approval and fixed missing connection cleanup.

title: Order API slow due to auth dependency
summary: Order-service latency increased even though its own CPU was normal. Auth-service CPU saturation caused downstream timeouts.
resolution: Scaled auth-service workers and fixed expensive token verification path.
